messages:
Morgan (AE): Quick sync on FinCo POC — we need to finalize success criteria, prompt inventory, and a baseline prompt set. Can SE + ML own collecting prompts and running the first eval?
Ravi (SE): Yep, I'll own prompt collection and the demo. Need scope confirmation: customer asked for support summarization and search reranking primarily — is that final?
Eli (ML Eng): From ML side we also need expected output shape (summary length, fields for extraction), gold examples, and acceptance thresholds. Proposing: embedding cosine >= 0.78 for rerank, ROUGE-L >= 0.42 for summaries, hallucination < 3% on sampled checks. Latency target: p50 <= 300ms, p95 <= 700ms for typical requests.
Sam (PM): Timeline draft: Kickoff (week0), ingest + prompt inventory (week1), baseline benchmarks (week2), iterate + customer demo (week3). Customer sounded like they wanted 4 weeks — propose 3wk core + 1wk buffer.
Morgan (AE): They requested pricing guidance too — likely to ask about Dedicated vs Hosted. We should propose trial credits and a commitment option. Chloe, any blockers in security questionnaire we should prep for?
Chloe (Legal): I'll take the vendor security questionnaire. Flag: FinCo requires KMS-backed keys and audit logs, plus potential on-prem/VPC requirement for PHI. That could push them to Dedicated/Private. Need their legal contact and data flows.
Ravi (SE): Action items for FinCo: please send 1) seed prompt examples, 2) 50 eval queries with expected outputs (where possible), 3) a ~200 doc subset as gold data. I'll also ask for acceptance thresholds per use case.
Eli (ML Eng): Baseline prompt-engineering guidance for the POC: run deterministic evals (temp=0, top_p=1) for metric comparability; for production explore temp 0.2 for summarization. Standard system prompt scaffold: ```System: You are a concise professional summarizer. User: "{document}" Please output <= 3 bullets, each <= 120 chars.``` Record token usage per request.
Ravi (SE): I'm creating a prompt inventory template (spreadsheet) — will include columns: prompt_id, use_case, role(system/user), few_shot_examples, expected_output, avg_input_tokens, notes. Uploading link now: https://docs.google.com/example (placeholder).
Morgan (AE): Pricing note: FinCo budgeted for a 30-day trial and then a decision on Dedicated. Sales will propose an accelerated path: 30-day hosted POC with optional Dedicated uplift if data residency needed. I'll draft numbers and share.
Sam (PM): For success criteria doc, propose a checklist we send as the POC acceptance criteria: 1) metrics pass (per-use-case thresholds), 2) infra SLOs met (latency + error rate), 3) security signoff (Legal/InfoSec), 4) handover artifacts (playbooks, eval scripts, prompt inventory).
Eli (ML Eng): Eval harness plan: combination of automated metrics and human spot checks. Automated: ROUGE, BLEU, exact-match, embedding-similarity. Human: sample 2-5% of outputs to label hallucination/incorrectness. For hallucination detection add a lightweight classifier plus manual audit.
Ravi (SE): Quick baseline prompts (examples to send now):
- Summarize: "Summarize the following insurance claim into 3 concise bullets focused on result and action items."
- Rerank: "Rank these answers by relevance to the query. Return only the rank order."
- Extraction: "Extract policy number, incident date, and claimant name from the text. If missing, write UNKNOWN."
Morgan (AE): Can SE upload initial prompt inventory to the SF opportunity by Friday? Also confirm who will run the live demo — Ravi or me?
Ravi (SE): I'll run the demo. I'll also ask FinCo to sign the narrow-scope NDA tweak for data transfer.
Chloe (Legal): NDA being reviewed. Also: need confirmation on encryption at rest, key management (bring-your-own-key?), and audit log retention period. If they require on-prem we need to loop infra.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: POC env created: poc-finco-1718204512 (endpoint: https://poc.redwood.example).
Sam (PM): Next steps recap: Ravi collects prompts & dataset; Eli prepares baseline eval scripts and runs initial pass; Chloe handles security Qs & NDA; Morgan finalizes pricing + kickoff email. Target: have initial benchmark results and prompt inventory by Friday. :thumbsup:
Morgan (AE): Thanks all — I'll update the opportunity and ping FinCo for the seed prompts today.
thread_summary: POC scoping and prompt inventory coordination for FinCo: roles assigned (SE, ML, Legal), baseline prompt templates and eval metrics proposed, timeline set (3wk core + 1wk buffer), security and pricing actions noted.
